# newsmood

> Tools to do semantic analysis on news


## Pages

- [newsmood](index.html.md): News-embedding trading-signal research substrate. Ingests financial news,
- [API reference](api.html.md): | &#96;newsmood&#96;   | newsmood — news-embedding trading signals.   |
- [newsmood](_autosummary/newsmood.html.md): newsmood — news-embedding trading signals.
- [newsmood.clusters](_autosummary/newsmood.clusters.html.md): Cluster-bucket features.
- [newsmood.data](_autosummary/newsmood.data.html.md): Pack local artifacts for publishing and download-on-miss from HF.
- [newsmood.embed](_autosummary/newsmood.embed.html.md): Embed canonical-DataFrame rows and load them into a vd collection.
- [newsmood.features](_autosummary/newsmood.features.html.md): Per-session features for news-driven prediction.
- [newsmood.infer](_autosummary/newsmood.infer.html.md): Train, persist, and apply a news-embedding signal model.
- [newsmood.ingest](_autosummary/newsmood.ingest.html.md): Ingest news from the local searches store into a canonical DataFrame.
- [newsmood.models](_autosummary/newsmood.models.html.md): Baseline walk-forward modeling on the news-feature panel.
- [newsmood.per_ticker_eval](_autosummary/newsmood.per_ticker_eval.html.md): End-to-end per-ticker evaluation.
- [newsmood.select](_autosummary/newsmood.select.html.md): Feature selection + regularization tuning for the news panel.
- [newsmood.targets](_autosummary/newsmood.targets.html.md): Price targets for news-driven prediction.
- [newsmood.tickers](_autosummary/newsmood.tickers.html.md): Per-ticker article matching: lightweight regex-based NER.
